Class State

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.State
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdventureState, BuildState, FinishScoreState, InitState
public abstract class State extends Object
Represents the abstract base class for game states in the state machine. Encapsulates the shared behavior and core transitions between states.
